THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for the construction of Grama Niladhari Oﬃ ce of Mahapothuwila and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land bearing name and containing following extent depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. MR/PTB/2021/385 dated 16.12.2021, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Siyambalagoda (Final Village Plan 12) in the Minor Division of Morawak Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pitabeddara in Matara District, Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Linthotamulla Okanda – Extent:0.0253 Hectare North: Linthotamulla Okanda claimed by Abeywickrama Batagodage Siripala; East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Linthotamulla Okanda claimed by Athuraliya Wickramage Inusha; West: Linthotamulla Okanda claimed by Athuraliya Wickramage Siripala.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
Ref. No. of Ministry of Land: 4-3/24/2020/HA/120.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for the construction of Divisional Secretariat, Pitabeddara and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. MR/PTB/2023/31 dated 28.04.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Pitabeddara (F.V.P. 06) in the Minor Division of Morawak Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pitabeddara in Matara District, Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Dankoluwa Watta Thennahena Part – Extent: 0.0595 Hectare North: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Pitabeddara B Watta claimed by Pradeep Kadahettige and others; East: Pitabeddara B Watta claimed by Pradeep Kadahettige and others and Lot B; South: Lot B and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha).

02. Lot ‘B’ – Pitabeddara B Watta – Extent: 0.4234 Hectare North: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Lot A and Pitabeddara B Watta claimed by Pradeep Kadahettige and others; East: Pitabeddara B Watta claimed by Rajapaksha Kankanamge Sanka Praveen, Sri Lanka Telecom, Chithra Rathnappuli, Abeywickrama, Pahuruthotage Somapala and others; South: Pitabeddara B Watta claimed by Abeywickrama, Pahuruthotage Somapala and others and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Lot A.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
Ref. No. of Ministry of Land: 4-3/24/2022/HA/184.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.08th January, 2025.
